I had a lot on my mind.
strings.(아르케가 서 있는 곳을 중심으로 하늘과 땅, 멀리 정령들이 평소의 모습: (Around where Arche stands, the sky, the earth, and the distant spirits are moving vigorously as usual.)
strings.하지만, 헤카테가 프뉴마와 아르케를 위협했잖아요: But Hecate threatened you and Pneuma.
I don't know what her intentions are, but things have returned to normal for now... So I'm trying to think of it as all right.
strings.프뉴마는 중요한 역할을 하는 장소니까 그분께서도 더 일을 벌이실 것 같진: Pneuma plays an important role, so I don't think she will cause any more trouble.
Now that Elysia and Pneuma are connected... Oh...
strings.설마, 비밀인가요?: Don't tell me it's a secret?
strings.아니에요. 비밀은 아니랍니다. 말씀드릴게요. 두 장소가 이어지면서 엘리시: No. It isn't a secret. I'll explain. Since the two places became connected, Elysia and Pneuma have begun influencing each other.
If Pneuma is endangered, Elysia will be endangered too.
So Lady Hecate will not threaten Pneuma lightly.
Then why did she threaten you and Pneuma...?
strings.프뉴마를 관리할 뿐인 제가 고대신인 헤카테 님의 뜻까지는 이해하진 못해서: I merely manage Pneuma. I cannot understand the will of an ancient god like Lady Hecate...
Of course you can't understand. The very idea of understanding a being like that...
strings.아셔야 할 게 있어요. 대부분의 신은 헤카테 님과 비슷한 입장을 보이고: There is something you should know. Most gods take a position similar to Lady Hecate's...
strings.고대신과 뒤틀린 자들 모두 이 세계를 사랑하는 게 아닌가요?: Don't the ancient gods and the Twisted Ones all love this world?
strings.세계를 사랑하는 건 같지만, 생명을 대하는 행동은 많이 다르세요. 모두가: They share a love for the world, but their treatment of living beings differs greatly. Not all are like Lady Seres, Lady Gaia, or Lady Iris.
In the Twilight era, the gods grew furious as soon as they discovered living beings who had taken the opposing side. It may seem harsh, but those beings were annihilated.
Along with the gods they served...
strings.헤카테 님의 입장에선 지금 이리스 님의 사람인 모험가님도 그때와 다르지: From Lady Hecate's perspective, you, a follower of Lady Iris, may be no different from those people.
So you must not try to understand gods through human thinking.
All right... Even so, it's frustrating...
It seems Hayden would like to see you.
strings.아이에 섬에 무슨 일이 있대요?: Has something happened on Aie Island?
No. It seems he wants to talk about the hourglasses...
Oh, the Hourglasses of Emotion. There are two left now.
The wish for passion and love, and the wish for hope and peace...
I accidentally brought them out of Pneuma, so I'll find them right away.
I understand what you mean. I'll find a way to resolve it.
strings.(아르케가 알겠다는 듯 고개를 끄덕이며 모험가를 배웅한다.): (Arche nods in understanding and sees the adventurer off.)
strings.(헤카테가 마녀들의 운명을 만들었다는 것도 신경 쓰여….): (But it bothers me that Hecate created the witches' destinies...)
I'll go see Hayden for now.
Hello, adventurer. Marie, you should say hello too.
strings.(헤이든이 품 안에 있는 인형에게 말을 걸자 마리가 고개를 살짝 들고 조: (When Hayden speaks to the doll in his arms, Marie lifts her head slightly and gives a quiet wave.)
strings.안녕하세요, 헤이든. 안녕, 마리. 그런데 마리, 너 지금 아무렇지도 않: Hello, Hayden. Hello, Marie. But Marie, you just moved as though it were perfectly normal.
strings.(헤이든이 당황한 표정으로 손으로 마리의 눈을 가린다.): (Looking flustered, Hayden covers Marie's eyes with his hand.)
strings.아, 헤이든은 정령이니까 이야기해도 되겠죠. 프뉴마의 일이니까…. 그게…: Oh, you're a spirit, so I suppose I can tell you. It concerns Pneuma... Well...
strings.(엘리시아라는 장소에 가서 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (You briefly explain what happened when you visited a place called Elysia.)
strings.%s 님의 이야기를 들으니 키르케가 저를 마음대로 했다는 것도 이해가 되: After hearing your story, %s, I understand how Circe could control me as she pleased.
A witch using... power received from a god...
strings.혹시 키르케 행방에 대해 아시나요?: Do you happen to know where Circe is?
No. I haven't learned anything since that incident.
strings.(헤이든이 뭔가 떠올랐는지 놀란 표정을 짓자 품 안에 있던 마리도 손을: (As Hayden looks startled by a sudden thought, Marie raises a hand in his arms.)
For a little while now, I've felt something strange around the island, including the theater.
strings.그게 모래시계가 아닐까 하고 글라우코스 님과 스킬라 님, 두 분과 함께: I thought it might be an hourglass, so Glaucos, Scylla, and I searched as carefully as grooming a Priring's fur, but we failed.
strings.그건 모험가님만 찾을 수 있는 거지만, 그래도 어디 있는지 파악할 수 있: Only you can find it, but I thought we might at least work out where it was.
So that you could find it right away when you came.
strings.흐음…. 그냥 가서 찾아도 안 되는 건데, 방법이 있다고요?: Hmm... Simply looking for it won't work, but you have another way?
strings.감정이 드러나지 않은 채 깊게 가라앉아 있어요. 그 감정을 건드릴 수 있: The emotions have sunk deep and remain hidden. We need something that can stir them.
strings.그게 있다면 감정의 모래시계가 떠오를 거예요. 엘리시아에서 시련을 겪었을: With that, the Hourglass of Emotion will surface. Please bring me the objects you encountered during the trials in Elysia.
There were two kinds of trial fragments... Fragments of Joy and Fragments of Sorrow...
Fragments won't do. Bring me one large piece of each.
All right. I'll go get them.
strings.(…큰 건 어떻게 구하지? 일단 엘리시아에 있는 이르판 님에게 물어볼까…: (...How do I get large ones? I should ask Irfan in Elysia... To think I have to enter the trials again...)
You acted as though you would never return, yet here you are because you need something.
strings.사막의 모래 같은 걸 들고 올 줄 알았는데…. 자, 이야기해보게. 표정에: I thought you might bring desert sand or something... Now, speak. Your face makes your dislike of me clear, but who knows...
Perhaps I can offer an answer to your story...
strings.(이르판에게 모래시계 이야기를 간단하게 전한다.): (You briefly tell Irfan about the hourglasses.)
If it concerns Pneuma, I should help.
strings.검은 달의 시련과 대지의 시련에서 자네가 만났던 시련의 슬픔 조각과 기쁨: Bring the Trial Fragments of Sorrow and Joy you encountered in the Black Moon Trial and the Trial of the Earth.
Then I will make larger ones for you.
strings.몇 개씩 구해오면 될까요?: How many of each do I need?
Bring three of each. I can make them for you whenever you need.
But before you enter the trials, tell me you intend to bring the trial fragments. Only then will they appear before you.
strings.일종의 퀘스트일세. 내게 알리지 않고 간다면 시련의 조각이 나오지 않으니: It is a sort of quest. Be careful: if you go without telling me, the trial fragments will not appear.
strings.이 정도면 설명이 됐을 거라 생각하고…. 어때, 해보겠나?: I think that explains it... Well, will you do it?
Yes... I hate the trials, but I have no choice...
strings.조각을 모아서 가져오는 대로 내가 바꿔줄 테니 바로 필요한 장소로 가보게: I will exchange the fragments as soon as you bring them. Then go straight to where you need them.
It's amazing to see objects like these tokens of a trial.
I've already dug a hole. We'll throw them in and bury them.
strings.그러면 시련을 극복한 기쁨과 슬픔의 감정들이 녹아서 극장 안으로 흘러 들: Then the feelings of joy and sorrow from overcoming the trials will dissolve and flow into the theater.
strings.(조금 의심스럽지만 해볼까?): (I'm a little doubtful, but shall we try?)
strings.(마리가 손을 들어 가리키는 구멍으로 시련의 기쁨과 슬픔을 던진다.): (You throw the Trial's Joy and Sorrow into the hole Marie points to.)
strings.(마리가 삽을 들고 흙으로 구멍을 메운다. 잠시 후, 헤이든의 앞에 보이: (Marie takes a shovel and fills the hole with soil. A moment later, the huge theater entrance in front of Hayden trembles.)
strings.이제 된 것 같네요…. 극장 안에 들어가 보세요. 이제 모래시계를 발견하: I think it's ready... Go inside the theater. You should be able to find the hourglass now.
strings.이제 마리는 숨길 생각 없는 거예요?: Are you no longer trying to hide that Marie can move?
(Apparently startled, Marie looks at Hayden and collapses where she stands, pretending to be dead.)
Thank you, %s. Marie will be happy too.
All right... I'll go find the hourglass, then.
strings.(다양한 무대가 세워져 있는 에우가몬 극장을 한참 동안 헤매던 중, 멀리: (After wandering for some time through the various stages of the Eugamon Theater, you see something glowing red in the distance.)
Is that it? Oh, yes. That's it...
strings.(빨간색 모래가 담겨 있는 모래시계를 손에 쥔 순간. 알 수 없는 감정들: (The moment you take hold of the hourglass filled with red sand, unfamiliar emotions flow into %s.)
It feels strangely hot... So these are feelings of passion and love...
They seem to suit Glaucos, the theater's owner.
strings.%s 님이 이곳으로 오시는 동안 모래시계 안에 있던 모래가 %s 님의 힘: While you were coming here, %s, the sand inside the hourglass reacted to your power, %s, and disappeared.
strings.어…, 그러면 어떻게 해야 하죠?: Oh... Then what should we do?
strings.걱정하지 마세요. 감정의 모래들은 자연스럽게 프뉴마로 돌아가는 정령들 사: Don't worry. The sand of emotion naturally mingled with the spirits returning to Pneuma.
The green one, right? Mir should know about that.
strings.미르가 어디 있는지 아세요?: Do you know where Mir is?
strings.안 그래도 요즘 고대 용님을 자주 뵈러 간다고 해요. 하시는 일 때문에: Apparently she's been visiting the ancient dragon often lately. His work has taken him far from where he usually stays...
The dragon's name was Atkina, wasn't it? Is he at the Burning Wheel...?
strings.아, 알아요. 헤이든, 그러면 나중에 봐요. 가서 미르에게 이야기를 들어: Oh, I know the place. I'll see you later, Hayden. I'll go talk with Mir.
strings.(불타는 수레바퀴에 들어서자 멀리에 커다란 몸집의 드래곤 아드키나가 서있: (Entering the Burning Wheel, you see the enormous dragon Atkina in the distance. He seems to be talking with someone nearby.)
Welcome, %s. It has been a while.
strings.미르와 잠깐 이야기를 하던 중이었지. 그래서 어디에서 뭘 많이 먹고 왔다: I was just talking with Mir. Now, where did you say you went to eat so much?
strings.에이, 아드키나 님. 제가 먹으러 돌아다니는 줄만 아시는 것 같은데, 아: Oh, Atkina. You make it sound as though I only travel around to eat. I don't! %s will get the wrong idea.
strings.그게 아니었단 말이냐?: Is that not what you do?
strings.안 그래도 그 소리가 언제쯤 들리나 했단다. 다른 건 모르겠지만, 신들께: I was wondering when I would hear that sound. Whatever else may be true, the gods must have blessed your stomach. It has already surpassed a dragon's.
strings.아드키나 님! 여자아이에게 그런 말씀을 쉽게 하시다니…. 위장이 각성했느: Atkina! How can you say such things so casually to a girl...? That my stomach has awakened or transcended...
strings.(대화내용이 이런건 미르가 있어서 그런 걸까?): (Is this conversation like this because Mir is here?)
strings.그렇긴 하지만요. 그거 아세요, 아드키나 님?: Well, that's true. But did you know, Atkina?
You have seen something interesting, haven't you?
strings.프레이오스 대륙의 글래스턴이란 도시에선 먹는 거로 대결하는 대회가 있대요: In a city called Glaston on the continent of Freios, they hold eating contests. Residents pay admission to watch them.
strings.신기하군. 그런 걸 보러 돈을 지불하다니…. 언제 한번 해보는 건 어떠냐: How curious. To pay money to watch such a thing... Why not try it sometime?
strings.후후, 은퇴 후에 해볼까요? 농담이에요. 나중에 휴가 때 같이 구경가는: Hehe, perhaps after I retire? I'm joking. How about we go watch together during my next vacation?
strings.그럴까? 아, 그러고 보니 내가 잊고 있었군. 이오가 잔뜩 가져온 음식이: Shall we? Oh, that reminds me. I had forgotten about the food Io brought in such quantities... You should join Mir and have some.
Wasn't that the food that made you angry when you tasted it...?
strings.화낸 게 아니네. 내 취향이 아니었던 것뿐이지. 다른 것도 있으니 사양하: I was not angry. It simply wasn't to my taste. There are other dishes too, so don't be shy.
strings.미르와 이야기하느라 자네 이야기 묻는 걸 깜박했군. 여기선 밖의 기운을: I was so busy talking with Mir that I forgot to ask about you. I cannot sense much of the outside world from here.
Oh, I was just about to tell you, Atkina...
Yes. That's why I came to see Atkina.
Tell me, then. I suspect it is no ordinary matter...
strings.(미르와 %s의 이야기를 듣던 아드키나의 표정이 굳어간다.): (Atkina's expression hardens as he listens to Mir and %s.)
strings.이름을 들으니 이제 기억나는 것 같군. 마녀들의 주인되는 신이라니. 그런: Now that I hear the name, I think I remember. A god who rules over witches? Such an absurd thing could not...
strings.그분께선 이미 프뉴마를 손대셨어요. 그리고 그분의 힘에 영향을 받은 마녀: She has already interfered with Pneuma. Witches influenced by her power are appearing, and a gate to the Demon Realm is about to connect.
Daphne's movements seem somewhat different, though...
strings.내가 나가서 좀 돕고 싶지만, 이곳을 유지하는 게 생각보다 힘들더군. 후: I would like to go out and help, but maintaining this place is more difficult than I expected. Sigh...
Atkina, please don't push yourself too hard.
Very well. I will not overdo it.
I'm investigating, so I'll tell you right away if I learn anything else.
If Lady Gaia awakens, this place should sustain itself... Very well, I understand.
strings.미르, 헤이든에게 들었는데 혹시 모래시계가 있는 곳을 알아요?: Mir, Hayden told me to ask. Do you know where the hourglass is?
Oh, yes. I do! It's in the Twilight Cathedral.
Wait, %s. Please listen for a moment.
strings.제가 리프트라시르를 지나다 성당 방향에서 이상한 기운이 느껴져서 가봤는데: I was passing through Lifthrasir when I sensed something strange toward the cathedral, so I went to look...
I asked the spirits flying in from Pneuma, and they confirmed it was an Hourglass of Emotion. I even went inside the cathedral to see if I could find it, but of course I couldn't.
I'm the one who brought them out of Pneuma, so I have to find them.
strings.그래서 필요한 게 있어요. 헤이든에게 가져다주신 것처럼 저도 그거 가져다: There's something we need first. Please bring me what you brought Hayden. What was it called?
Yes, that sounds right. Bring those to me.
Then I'll go get them and bring them back.
Thank you for your kind wishes.
strings.%s 님, 저! 그동안 성당에 가 있을게요. 악마들을 피해서 지붕있는 쪽: %s, I'll go to the cathedral while you do that! I'll hide near the roof to avoid the devils, so come there.
strings.(…다시 엘리시아에 가는게 좀 귀찮지만, 어쩔 수 없지.): (...Going back to Elysia is a bother, but it can't be helped.)
strings.오, 모험가님이다! 여기서 대화가 길어지면 모험가님은 악마들에게 공격당해: Oh, adventurer! If we talk too long here, the devils may attack you and make you use the Resurrection Essence you've been saving for later.
So I'll finish quickly. One, two, three!! All done.
strings.이제 성당에서 남은 초록 모래시계를 찾을 수 있어요. 아무 말도 하지 않: Now you can find the remaining green hourglass in the cathedral. I'll send you off without another word, so go straight to the final room and find it! Understood?
strings.그리고 찾은 물건은 여기 촌장 어르신에게 주시면 돼요! 그러면 저는 끝!: And give what you find to the local village chief! Then I'm done! I'll be going! You don't need to hear that again, do you?
strings.(빛이 가득해 성스러운 느낌이 가득한 공간 끝에 초록색 빛으로 빛나는 모: (At the far end of a space filled with holy light stands an hourglass glowing green.)
Why didn't I notice it last time? It's so easy to spot...
strings.(초록 모래시계를 쥐고 가져가려고 하는 순간, 빨간 모래시계를 얻었던 때: (The moment you take the green hourglass, various emotions flow into %s, just as when you found the red one.)
strings.따뜻하네…. 희망과 평화를 바라는 감정이라더니…. 다들 신에게 바라는 마: It's warm... The wish for hope and peace... I suppose everyone wishes for the same things from the gods...
Maybe it's even stronger because this is a cathedral.
strings.그런데 이걸 가지고 왜 리프 소장님에게 가보라고 하는 거지?: But why did she tell me to take this to Director Lif?
I haven't come to consult you about plans for my retirement...
strings.에이, 설마. 제가 지금 그런 말 할 거라고 생각하셨나요?: Oh, come now. Did you think I was going to say that?
I was going to ask whether you'd brought what Mir requested.
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize... Here you are.
It's all right. Hehe. I was about to say something similar.
strings.리프트라시르 주민이라면 프레이오스 대륙 전역에서도 알아주는 각종 혜택이: Residents of Lifthrasir receive all sorts of benefits recognized throughout Freios, so do give it some thought.
This isn't an opportunity that comes every day! Hehe.
strings.모래시계네요? 초록색으로 빛나는 모래시계라니…. 성당에 이런 게 있었나?: An hourglass? An hourglass glowing green... Was something like this in the cathedral?
strings.너무 오래돼서 기억나지 않을 줄 알았는데…. 그 사람이 지키려고 했던 감: I thought it had been too long for me to remember... But the feelings that person wanted to protect are coming back so vividly...
I wonder if I should tell you...
It's all right. I know how to keep a secret.
A spirit told me to bring it to you, so you must be no ordinary person...
strings.후우, 그러면 말씀드릴게요. 정령의 세계에서 제가 나올 때 따라 나온 감: Sigh... Then I'll tell you. When I left the spirit world, some emotions followed me out, turned into hourglasses, and scattered everywhere.
strings.그래서 그걸 제가 찾고, 정령을 만나야 해요. 잠깐만, 그걸 리프 소장님: So I have to find them and take them to a spirit. Wait, if I have to give it to you...
strings.우리 마을엔 그런 이야기가 있어요. 엘프 마을의 수호 정령이 오래 살다: There is a story in our village. An elf village's guardian spirit lived for so long that it eventually began living like an ordinary elf...
strings.전설 같은 말씀을 아무렇지도 않게 말씀하시는데, 본인 이야기 하시는 건가: You say something that sounds like a legend so casually. Are you talking about yourself?
strings.(리프가 멋쩍게 웃으며 모래시계를 품에 안는다. 잠시 후, 안에 있던 초: (With an awkward smile, Lif cradles the hourglass. Soon, the green sand inside begins to glow and flow out.)
strings.여신이시여. 부족한 이 엘프를 이끄소서…. 다시는 과오가 반복되지 않도록: O goddess, guide this unworthy elf... I will strive never to repeat my mistakes... Now, return...
strings.(리프의 말과 함께 반짝이던 초록색 모래는 그대로 하늘 위로 올라가 마을: (At Lif's words, the sparkling green sand rises into the sky, circles the village once, and disappears somewhere.)
strings.저는 리프트라시르의 촌장이니까요. 축복을 받아 정령과 소통할 수 있는 것: I am Lifthrasir's village chief. I have simply been blessed with the ability to communicate with spirits.
strings.빈 모래시계는 제가, 아니 별의 노래에 두고 보관할게요. 미르에게 그렇게: I'll keep the empty hourglass... I mean, we'll keep it in the Song of the Stars. I asked Mir if that was all right, and she said yes.
strings.그래요? 별의 노래 안이라면 안심이 되네요. 신의 메시지를 전하는 정령이: Really? I'll feel safe leaving it in the Song of the Stars. A spirit who delivers the gods' messages has approved it, after all.
%s, village work is piling up, so I need to go.
I'd like to tell you more about the business, %s, but I'm sorry, I'm busy.
You can tell me about the business next time. Wait, business? What do you mean...?
Now that I've collected all the hourglasses, I should let Arche in Pneuma know...
strings.%s 님 덕분에 모래시계에 들어있던 감정들이 다시 돌아왔어요. 정령들도: Thanks to you, %s, the emotions inside the hourglasses have returned. The spirits are full of life again too.
strings.고생 많으셨어요. 지금 기분은 어떠세요?: You worked hard. How are you feeling now?
I'm feeling better. Coming to Pneuma has definitely eased my anxiety.
Even so, you should get some rest.
I suppose I should. Who knows what will happen next...
strings.다시 아에루라를 불러올까요?: Shall I call the Aerura again?
...I like how soft the Aerura are.
strings.(아르케가 %s의 쓸쓸한 표정을 읽고는 고개를 끄덕인다. 잠시 후, 프뉴: (Reading the loneliness on %s's face, Arche nods. Soon, several Aerura roaming Pneuma's skies approach %s.)
The Aerura have come to offer you a place beside them. Rest well.
If I fall asleep here, won't it inconvenience you, Arche...?
strings.후후, 그런 건 걱정하지 마세요. 저는 그동안 프뉴마를 돌아다니면서 정령: Hehe, don't worry about that. I'll be traveling around Pneuma to check on the spirits in the meantime.
strings.푹 잠드셔도 괜찮아요. 시간이 되면 카이로스와 크로노스가 와서 깨워줄 거: You can sleep soundly. Kairos and Chronos will come wake you when it's time.
strings.(그러면 다른 건 걱정하지 말고 잠깐 눈을 붙여볼까….): (Then shall I stop worrying about everything else and close my eyes for a while...?)
strings.(그렇게 깊은 잠에 빠져든다. 그래도 조금은 개운하게 깨어날 하루를 기다: (And so, you drift into a deep sleep, awaiting a day when you can wake feeling at least a little more refreshed...)
